name: tradevault
description: Mobile-first TradeVault dashboard using the 100k-pchip-v1 sizing model and fixed gross 1:1 RR.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run test:worker-local && npm run test:e2e && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name tradevault100k --branch master
scripts.deploy:compatibility: wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name tradevault --branch master
scripts.deploy:all: npm run check && npm run deploy:worker && npm run test:sync-backend && npm run deploy:cloudflare && npm run deploy:compatibility
